RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so your sex was not a factor in the selection decision. Raising sex discrimination or questioning the panel's gender composition would have no legal basis and would seriously damage your professional reputation and relationships within the municipality. 

While an all-male panel may reflect broader institutional diversity shortcomings, it does not demonstrate bias between two male applicants. Senior municipal roles frequently prioritize public consultation, political acumen, or internal fit over formal technical qualifications. 

Do not raise the panel's composition. Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiry regarding your feedback request, framing it constructively around professional development and understanding what competencies the municipality prioritized.
